user.title: Set up Adlos
user.description: Enter the connection details for your Adlos instance.

data.url: PocketBase Server URL (e.g. https://pocket.nextbee.org or up to /api)

send_message.name: Send Message
send_message.description: Sends an encrypted text message or photo to one or multiple Adlos users.

message.name: Message
message.description: The main message text to send.

target.name: Target
target.description: User Name(s), Contact ID(s) or Room name(s).

camera.name: Camera Entity
camera.description: Optional camera entity (e.g. camera.hauseingang) for live snapshot delivery.

image.name: Image Path / URL
image.description: Optional local path or URL (e.g. /config/www/snapshot.jpg or https://...).

send_photo.name: Send Photo
send_photo.description: Sends an encrypted photo to one or multiple Adlos users.

message.name: Caption / Text
message.description: Optional text to accompany the photo.

camera.name: Camera Entity
camera.description: Optional camera entity (e.g. camera.hauseingang) for snapshot delivery.

path.name: File Path
path.description: Local path to the image file (e.g. /config/www/snapshot.jpg).

image.name: Image Path / URL
image.description: Alternative parameter for image file path or URL.

target.name: Target
target.description: User Name(s), Contact ID(s) or Room name(n).

register_user.name: Register User
register_user.description: Registers an Adlos user Contact ID and name for notifications (e.g. called upon QR code scan).

contact_id.name: Contact ID
contact_id.description: The 15-character Adlos contact ID of the user.

name.name: User Name
name.description: Optional display name of the user.

unregister_user.name: Unregister User
unregister_user.description: Removes an Adlos Contact ID from the registered recipients.
